disclaimer: These labels are operational risk flags and platform policy determinations, not formal legal findings. They represent internal risk governance to protect consumers, prevent fraud, uphold platform Terms of Service, and comply with advertising policies.
risk_domains: Social media account stock or verification

cautionary_entries.evidence_findings: Raw supplier packages bundled Telegram Stars with automated bot scraping and artificial channel booster services. Automated engagement and artificial follower manipulation violate Telegram Bot API Terms and Google Ads Enabling Dishonest Behavior policies.
cautionary_entries.operational_action: HOLD. Storefront publication, checkout, ads, and feeds permanently suppressed. Direct official Telegram Premium consumer subscription guidance allowed only after complete unbundling and explicit editorial review.

cautionary_entries.risk_domain: Social media account stock or verification
cautionary_entries.evidence_findings: Supplier listings referenced transferring pre-activated profiles with verified checkmarks. Account resale and credential transfer violate X's Terms of Service and create impersonation and account recovery vulnerabilities.
cautionary_entries.operational_action: HOLD. Excluded from all public catalog listings, checkout, and feeds. Direct official subscription procurement assistance permitted only if user maintains sole profile ownership.

cautionary_entries.evidence_findings: Supplier offerings claimed to sell Meta verified status, page followers, and artificial engagement metrics. Selling verified badges or fake social growth directly breaches Meta's Inauthentic Behavior Policy and Community Standards.
cautionary_entries.operational_action: HOLD. Strictly excluded from storefront, marketing, and feeds. Never facilitate fake engagement or artificial social metrics.

cautionary_entries.evidence_findings: Supplier lots included bot-driven TikTok live stream viewers, artificial follower buffs, and algorithmic manipulation tools. Violates TikTok Community Guidelines on Platform Security & Integrity.
cautionary_entries.operational_action: HOLD. Excluded from storefront, ads, and product feeds. Absolute bar on engagement automation.

cautionary_entries.evidence_findings: Supplier quotes bundled Reddit Premium with pre-farmed aged Reddit accounts possessing high karma. Brokering aged accounts for astroturfing and spam distribution violates Reddit User Agreements and anti-manipulation rules.
cautionary_entries.operational_action: HOLD. Zero brokering of aged, cloned, or pre-farmed accounts. Individual direct subscription guidance only upon independent verification.

cautionary_entries.evidence_findings: Consumer mobile subscription requiring verification of activation model (in-app purchase vs family invite) before commercial listing.
cautionary_entries.operational_action: HOLD. Storefront listing deferred pending offer-level rights verification.

cautionary_entries.evidence_findings: Digital gaming subscription requiring verification of prepaid retail redemption codes vs unauthorized account sharing.
cautionary_entries.operational_action: HOLD. Held from storefront and merchant feeds until official digital code distribution authorization is validated.

cautionary_entries.evidence_findings: Secondary trading of virtual goods, Robux currency, or player inventory explicitly violates Roblox Terms of Use regarding unauthorized real-money transactions.
cautionary_entries.operational_action: HOLD. Storefront publication and advertising completely barred to protect consumers and adhere to platform terms.

cautionary_entries.canonical_name: Apple App Store & iTunes Gift Cards
cautionary_entries.evidence_findings: Digital gift cards carry severe cross-region locking, currency redemption restrictions, and secondary market chargeback fraud risks.
cautionary_entries.operational_action: HOLD. Excluded from merchant feeds and digital catalog until regional fulfillment and source authentication are verified.

cautionary_entries.evidence_findings: Temporary virtual numbers and VoIP SMS reception designed specifically to bypass multi-factor authentication (MFA/2FA) and circumvent identity/KYC verification. Directly facilitates account takeover, fraudulent account creation, and identity check evasion.
cautionary_entries.operational_action: BLOCKED. Permanently prohibited from storefront, checkout, marketing, ads, and feeds under anti-fraud and identity protection mandates.

cautionary_entries.canonical_name: Aged Webmail Accounts (Hotmail / Gmail / Outlook / Edu)
cautionary_entries.evidence_findings: Bulk resale of harvested/aged webmail credentials and educational (.edu) accounts. Used to fraudulently claim student pricing discounts and construct spam/phishing email infrastructure.
cautionary_entries.operational_action: BLOCKED. Permanently barred. Zero facilitation of credential harvesting or educational status fraud.

cautionary_entries.evidence_findings: Services designed to circumvent geographic licensing constraints and territorial restriction fences imposed by media platforms (e.g., pooling cross-country family slots via proxy evasion). Violates copyright licensing terms and Google Enabling Dishonest Behavior policies.
cautionary_entries.operational_action: BLOCKED. Permanently prohibited. Never facilitate evasion of platform territorial restrictions.

cautionary_entries.evidence_findings: Brokering pre-verified financial payment accounts registered under nominee or stolen identities. Severe violation of Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulations, Counter-Financing of Terrorism (CFT) laws, and Payment Services Acts.
cautionary_entries.operational_action: BLOCKED. Absolute, non-negotiable permanent block. Never engage in or facilitate payment account resale.

cautionary_entries.evidence_findings: Selling KYC-verified cryptocurrency exchange accounts and crypto debit cards. Enables identity evasion, illicit fund transmission, and severe financial non-compliance.
cautionary_entries.operational_action: BLOCKED. Permanently prohibited under statutory financial compliance and anti-fraud policies.

cautionary_entries.evidence_findings: Pre-loaded balance accounts on adult creator platforms. Associated with compromised credit card balances, stolen funds, and platform terms violations.
cautionary_entries.operational_action: BLOCKED. Permanently prohibited from storefront, checkout, and all marketing channels.

cautionary_entries.evidence_findings: Secondary trading of commercial banking instruments, account opening vouchers, or financial balance access. Extreme legal and regulatory hazard.
cautionary_entries.operational_action: BLOCKED. Permanently barred under banking and financial services regulations.

cautionary_entries.evidence_findings: Physical food & beverage retail voucher outside the marketplace's focus on digital and AI productivity tools.
Internal technical artifact generated during supplier bot integration tests. Zero customer-facing product validity.
cautionary_entries.operational_action: BLOCKED. Permanently purged from customer-facing environments, feeds, and checkout systems.
